caseName: In the Matter of James Cally
caseNameFull: In the Matter of James Cally. No. D-807. Former Decision, 492 U.S. 941, 110 S.CT. 32. June 11, 1990. It Having Been Reported to the Court That James J. Cally Has Died, the Rule to Show Cause, Heretofore, Issued on September 25, 1989, is Hereby Discharged

opinions.text: It having been reported to the Court that James J. Cally has died, the rule to *923 show cause, heretofore issued on September 25, 1989 [492 U. S. 941], is hereby discharged.
